Kindred|jgl.identity: Physical damage marksman in the jungle who scales through marks. Her passive spawns marks on monsters and champions; hunting them permanently increases her range and damage. Dance of Arrows (Q) dashes while firing, Wolf's Frenzy (W) creates a zone where Wolf attacks, Mounting Dread (E) slows, then triggers a Wolf strike (damage based on missing health), and Lamb's Respite (R) creates a zone where no one can die for a few seconds.
Kindred|jgl.playstyle: Farming, mark-hunting ranged carry jungler. Kindred scales with her stacks: the more she has, the more she dominates. She has to take risks to collect marks in the enemy jungle, which makes her vulnerable to invades.
Kindred|jgl.early_game: Clear fast with W and Q. Collect monster marks (they often spawn in the enemy jungle) when it's safe. Gank when a laner can follow up: E to slow, Q, attacks.
Kindred|jgl.level_1: Wolf's Frenzy (W) first. Wolf attacks camps with you.
Kindred|jgl.level_2: Dance of Arrows (Q). A dash and attack speed: your clear speeds up.
Kindred|jgl.level_3: Mounting Dread (E). Slows, then Wolf strikes after three attacks: first gank possible.
Kindred|jgl.level_6: Lamb's Respite: a zone where no one can die for a few seconds. Use it to save your team from a burst or to survive a dive. Careful: it also protects enemies inside the zone.
power_spikes: Mark stacks: more range and damage.
Kindred|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear and mark hunting: marks permanently increase your range and damage. Monster marks often spawn in the enemy jungle: take them when your laners have priority. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Avoid duels against junglers who dive you.
Kindred|jgl.trading: Ganking: E → attacks → Q to keep your distance. Skirmishing: stay at range, hit and use R to save your team from a burst. Give up on it against CC tanks (Rammus) or junglers who dive you.
threats: Invades and duels against diving junglers.
Using R at the wrong time and saving the enemies.
mistakes: Ignoring marks: your scaling depends on them.
Casting R when the enemies benefit more from the zone.

matchup_notes.Graves: Kite him and save R for his burst.
matchup_notes.Rammus: His taunt cancels your attacks: don't attack him during his Defensive Ball Curl.
matchup_notes.Wukong: His clone fools you: save R for his knock-up.

Kindred|jgl.mid_game: Mark hunting, objectives and skirmishes. Kindred scales into a ranged carry.
Kindred|jgl.late_game: Ranged carry: stay behind your frontline, hit and save R to rescue your team.
Kindred|jgl.ahead: Hunt marks, take objectives and force fights.
Kindred|jgl.behind: Farm and scale: your late game makes up for falling behind.
Kindred|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to stack marks and become a ranged carry in teamfights.
Kindred|jgl.final_tip: Before casting Lamb's Respite, check that it saves more of your allies than enemies.
